prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +1.2% after noise correction across 6 tests with 2 wins, though 4 tests showed no clear effect.
Finish redesigns (finish, redesign) are helpful, averaging +1.2% after noise correction across 5 tests with 1 win, though 4 tests showed no clear effect.
Path choice redesigns (choose_path, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests, averaging +0.1% after noise correction.
Evidence is still thin for adoption changes (adoption, new_flow; adoption, new_screen; adoption, redesign) with only 1 test each.
Predictions are often too high, overestimating noise-corrected impact in most tests.
Predictions can sometimes underestimate actual impact, as seen in round 6 (+1.5% predicted vs +2.9% noise-corrected) and round 7 (+2.2% predicted vs +4.4% noise-corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +1.2% after noise correction, 5 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.2% after noise correction, 6 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign in cloud save and pet recovery hint: Adds an explicit recovery reassurance hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in syncs existing pets across devices. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, causing user drop-off during sign-in.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick friend carousel showcase redesign: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a full visual carousel with enlarged pet preview art and emotion highlights. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%) and long decision time (median 89s). A visually rich carousel simplifies pet selection.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pet animation and voice preview flow: Adds interactive sound and animation preview components directly to the pet choice cards before photo uploading. (why: Adoption conversion drops sharply to 60.9%. Interactive motion previews build emotional connection before users commit.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign in immediately before home intro: Moves the sign-in step after pet waiting, placing sign-in right before the final home intro screen. (why: Earlier lessons confirm reordering sign-in boosts overall conversion (+1.2% average). Moving sign-in after pet setup reduces initial friction.)
4: [home, redesign] Waiting screen live generation stage redesign: Redesigns the generation waiting screen into a stage layout with animated progress and real-time status updates. (why: The waiting step has high median/mean dwell times (median 201s, mean 2336s), causing high abandoned window drop-offs.)
5: [home, wait_info] Pet generation ready notification toggle: Adds desktop ready notification toggles and explicit time estimates to the pet generation waiting screen. (why: Long mean wait time (2336s) causes users to minimize the desktop window and forget to return to complete onboarding.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Lightweight app footprint path choice copy: Updates choose_path copy to highlight fast setup times and low desktop performance impact. (why: Choose path has 76.2% conversion and extreme mean time (514s), indicating hesitation about app requirements and path complexity.)
7: [finish, redesign] Home intro split desktop placement redesign: Redesigns home_intro into a split layout showing desktop pet placement preview alongside launch controls. (why: Finish screen conversion is only 71.0% with high mean dwell time (5815s) and 3 support emails reporting confusion on how to display or control pets.)
8: [sign_in, notification] Account pet sync status notification on sign in: Adds an account sync status banner to the sign-in screen displaying automatic pet recovery status. (why: 8 support emails were received about missing pets after logging back in. Proactive sync status prevents sign-in churn.)
